definitionZh: 规则-color CSS 短手属性定义了多列网格,弹性,多列布局中列和行之间所绘制的线条的颜色,将列和行规则的颜色设置为相同的值.
sourceDefinition: The rule-color CSS shorthand property defines the colors of the lines drawn between columns and rows in multi-column grid, flex, and multi-col layouts, setting the colors of the column and row rules to the same value.
